## 5eab486dd6f3

**Reproduced generation failure and dead controls.** In a 3,000-draw sweep, 2/1,000 easy samples failed the generator's own `self_check`. At seed 497 / sample index 16, the two red exemplar stamps become orthogonally connected, so the rule sees one exemplar instead of two. `self_check` reports `expected two exemplar components and one query, found 1 / 1`, and the canonical Racket rule fails on that generated input with a missing-object error.

The advertised exact controls `shape`, `query_shape`, `palette_kind`, and helpful `texture` are also behaviorally dead: each pair of distinct requested values produced byte-identical grids in 50/50 matched-seed comparisons. This can make an override audit or curriculum request appear successful without changing the data.

Evidence: `checks/audit/5eab486dd6f3/probe.json`, `invalid_input.json`, `racket.json`, and `racket_exit.txt`. Audited generator SHA-256: `ddec84717995b2ef0d9a1cf9af7cfff92f1b7578194420199b1dbee57d30e1cf`. No fix was made because this is an audit-only target.
